positions.title: Software Application Engineer
positions.description:
Actively contributing to the modernization of critical rail infrastructure through advanced software engineering and cross-disciplinary collaboration.

Support the development, integration, and deployment of the MARTA Control Center System, focusing on Automatic Train Supervision (ATS), SCADA, and Security subsystems.

Design, implement, and test high-performance software components in C and C++ on both Linux and Windows, supporting the migration from 32-bit to 64-bit architectures.

Leverage STL, Boost, and Qt to build scalable, maintainable applications that interface with vital railway hardware such as signals, switches, track circuits, and train telemetry.

Lead efforts in requirements management, defect tracking, source control, and traceability to ensure safety-critical compliance and technical excellence.

Coordinate across engineering disciplines and external partners to manage technical performance, schedule, scope, and budget, ensuring smooth project delivery and customer acceptance.

Implement and optimize inter-process communication (IPC) mechanisms and apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles to architect robust, reliable systems.

Actively troubleshoot complex system-level issues involving memory, performance, and compatibility.

Contribute to the full software lifecycle — from initial design to field deployment — while exploring integration opportunities with AI and machine learning technologies.

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.locationName: Cobb County, Georgia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Designing and implementing C++ software supporting time-critical real time operations, including signal processing and hardware control interfaces.

Integrating software with complex hardware systems, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams of systems engineers and testers.

Debugging multi-threaded C++ applications and optimizing code for low-latency performance under constrained embedded hardware conditions.

Utilizing network protocols (UDP, TCP) for data transmission and diagnostics, capturing and analyzing packets with Wireshark to validate system communication.

Developing automation testing frameworks to verify functional correctness and performance of radar subsystems.

Maintaining and deploying software in RHEL 8/RHEL 9 Linux and Windows 10 environments, utilizing scripting (Bash, PowerShell) and containerization (Docker) where appropriate.

Supporting software configuration management with Git, issue tracking with JIRA, document management using Confluence, and managing MRs through GitLab.

Participate in classified defense projects, adhering security compliance protocols while working in secure lab environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Testing · Network Engineering · Research · Integration · Team Leadership · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Programming · Software Development · Cisco Networking

positions.title: Integration Engineer
positions.description:
Tested and commissioned operational technology, verifying that it met electro-mechanical specifications.  
Performed I/O checks, calibrated sensors, worked with CAN bus, diagnosed PLC issues, read electrical diagrams, and commissioned IPCs. Integrated operation technologies (OT) with IT infrastructure within warehousing platforms.  Managed teams of operators to help with testing subsystems in order to achieve desired outcomes.  Talked with customers about test performance.  Became a subject matter expert in ADAPTO Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS): commissioning, integrating, and maintaining.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Troubleshooting · Teamwork · Testing · Network Engineering · Customer Requirements · Integration · Commissioning · Programming

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description: Worked in customer service providing desktop support, networking, and sales assistance.  I set up computers on different networks, create office 365 and exchange email accounts, manage servers, troubleshoot scanners, backup networks, set up VPN and RDP shortcuts, configure phones, routers, switches, firewalls, install hardware onsite, run network cabling, and work with telecom subcontractors. I also sell personalized PCs to corporations and clients catering specifications to their networking needs.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Network Engineering · Customer Service · Technical Support · LAN-WAN · Windows System Administration · Windows Server · Cisco Networking

positions.title: Aero-Thermal Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked with ANSYS Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software creating CAD designs of centrifugal compressors used in HVAC applications.  Specifically, I have worked on diffusers, seals, and IGV designs having filed a patent for several seal designs I have made. I have also worked on full scale digital compressor models which use test data to calibrate the model and produce a better CPR prediction reducing test time.  I have designed scripts to process data, smooth 3 dimensional contour plots, and produce reports with aero-thermal data.  I have also collaborated with collogues in the testing, mechanical, and manufacturing departments on different projects.  Within my department I work on an aero-thermal engineering team of 6 people where we collaborate daily on compressor design, test data processing, and CFD research.

positions.title: Laboratory Technician
positions.description: R&D of Nb3Sn superconducting wires' magnetic and mechanical properties.  Mounted and polished mechanically strained wires to observe microstructure changes at different amounts of strain. Used digital and scanning electron microscopes, auto-polisher, diamond saw, and vibromats in my day to day work.  For analysis I would use ImageJ, Photoshop, and OLYMPUS Stream motion software to capture data about the crack density as well as the density of certain intermetallic phases. Produced an epsilon phase vs heat treatment graph and produced microscope images for a reserach paper.
